items.summary: The Icelandic hosting company 1984 ehf. temporarily shut down all of its services after a serious cyber attack, Vísir reported on 20 November 2026. The company said the systems were closed deliberately to stop the attack, and that it does not know whether any data were stolen. Wagyu, the issuer of the XMR1 token, claims that an issuing key stored on a deleted server at 1984 was leaked; that claim is unconfirmed.
